responsibility: This header provides libgccjit’s C++ API as a thin inline wrapper over the C API. It defines the gccjit namespace class hierarchy for contexts, objects, types, functions, blocks, values, asm, timers, and convenience operators, mapping method calls and overloaded operators directly onto gcc_jit_* entrypoints while offering a more idiomatic C++ surface. Its responsibility is the public C++ binding layer, not the underlying compiler implementation.
